J1.evidence: Arabic «والله منصوب على التعظيم» is rendered «الله ta'zîm üzere mansûbdur»; the explanation that the author avoids calling لفظ الجلالة mafʿūl bihi out of reverence is properly marked as [Mütercim notu: …] and reflects the well-known convention behind the phrase منصوب على التعظيم. Rest of Turkish is complete and accurate.

J2.evidence: Arabic «والله منصوب على التعظيم» is translated faithfully as «الله ta'zîm üzere mansûbdur»; the explanation of why the author avoids «مفعول به» for the Divine Name is properly inside a [Mütercim notu: …] and reflects the well-known convention of i'rab authors; no unmarked addition or error. Rest of the Turkish matches the Arabic.
